releaseSource.title: Autodesk Inventor 2027.2 what's new - Design & Manufacturing

calls.name: iProperties.ValueInDoc
calls.evidence: The Inventor 2014 help lists iProperties.ValueInDoc under deprecated functions from previous iLogic versions, which still work in a rule, and says iProperties.Value is preferred.
calls.sourceQuote: the iProperties.Value function is preferred instead of these older functions.
calls.note: The only source describing it is the 2014 help, which marks it deprecated. Nothing provided covers release 2027.2.
calls.query: Inventor iLogic and API reference iProperties.ValueInDoc

calls.name: ThisDoc.Document
calls.evidence: The Advanced API Functions Reference (2026 help) documents ThisDoc.Document as returning the document in which the current rule is stored, as an Inventor.Document object.
calls.note: Documented without any deprecation marking; only the older syntax iLogicVb.RuleDocument is mentioned as an alternative, and the page is for 2026 rather than 2027.2.
calls.query: Inventor iLogic and API reference ThisDoc.Document

calls.name: MessageBox.Show
calls.evidence: The Message Box Functions Reference documents MessageBox.Show as the base iLogic function for showing a message box, with no deprecation or removal marking.
calls.sourceQuote: Acts as the base for the Message Box functions in iLogic. Use this function to show a message box.
calls.note: The documentation is from the 2022 and 2024 releases, not 2027.2, but nothing in it marks the call as deprecated or removed.
calls.query: Inventor iLogic and API reference MessageBox.Show
